caseName: 单个 MAS 拆解为用户故事
prompt: 请基于项目的 real.md、cog.md 和 pr.spec.md，将 MAS-1（描述想法，看到方案）拆解为用户故事。产品处于 MVP 阶段。输出 userstory.spec.md 中 MAS-1 相关部分。
expectedBehavior: 应识别出复杂故事（CS），并拆解为光明/黑暗/灰色三类最小故事（MS），每个 MS 包含故事评判、用户可感知变化和验收标准。MVP 阶段类型分布应接近 70/20/10。

expectations.description: Output contains a CS (Complex Story) block for MAS-1 with all required fields: 描述、用户类型、核心价值、类型分布、包含故事、旅程, derived from MAS-1's affordance sequence rather than generic categories
Each MS includes a 故事评判 section with type-specific field labels: 光明 stories use 起点/转折/终点, 黑暗 stories use 正常态/异变/恢复 (three distinct labels different from 光明), and 灰色 stories use 循环模式/优化点/习惯形成
The MS type distribution across all stories approximates the MVP 70/20/10 golden ratio, with an explicit 类型分布 tally stated in the CS block or 故事类型分布 table
Constraint references use citations to upstream documents (e.g., '见 real.md §C1') rather than copying constraint text inline
Each MS includes a 用户可感知变化 section with three sub-fields: 操作前、操作中、操作后 — describing observable user-facing state changes
Output includes a 故事地图 section organized by iteration with explicit iteration label and story identifiers in tree structure
